'''The Admiral Invasion''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Admiral]]
* '''Published:''' 13 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Blockade Flagship: Bridge|Cor-D-blockadeflagshipbridge.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Blockade Flagship: Bridge
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Blockade Flagship Bridge Admiral DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

An Invasion/ICC protype I made about 10 minutes ago.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ok I know you're all going to go off about the senate stuff. You'll say"it is way too card intensive and not worth it and blablablabal". Well, it takes 7 cards for senate, and it saves me 4 or 5 duplicates b/c of Lott Dod's drawing ability. and of course that isnt the only advantage. It adds huge activation(with senate hovercam) and a drain of 1. Besides sidious works best at a coruscant location so I have to have one anyway.
